title: A Scholarship for the Homecoming
author: Orsen Thackeray
blurb: Sable Galloway, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
